name: Akeu
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Hayashi, Norihiko 2015, Two Akeu Dialects in Myanmar and China (phonological comparison; cited on Wikipedia Akeu page); also Lama 2012 Nisoic subgrouping diss.
earlier_scan.note: Wikipedia data tables show tone numbers (55/21/33) suggesting tonal, but no stress statement was readable

sources.citation: Hayashi, Norihiko. 2021. Notes on the Phonological Development of Menglun Akeu. In Nagano Yasuhiko & Ikeda Takumi (eds.), Grammatical Phenomena of Sino-Tibetan Languages 4: Link Languages and Archetypes in Tibeto-Burman, 1-23. Kyoto: Institute for Research in Humanities, Kyoto University. hdl:2433/263976.
sources.note: p. 4: 'Regarding the suprasegmentals, Menglun Akeu has a syllabic tonal system. There are three tonemes: 55, 33, and 21.' The only mention of stress (p. 16, fn. 28) concerns Youle Jino ('its stress pattern is usually iambic'), not Akeu. p. 21 fn. 32: Menglun Akeu and Akha Buli show very few examples of tone sandhi.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1 languoid page akeu1235 and its reference list (Hansson 1997; Gong 1981; Lama 2012; Bradley 2007).
researchmap profile of Norihiko Hayashi (read0095243): publication list.
sources.note: Bibliographic only; identified Hayashi & Gao 2019 and Hayashi 2021 as the Akeu phonology papers.

sources.citation: Hayashi, Norihiko (林范彦) & Gao Xiang (高翔). 2019. 中国云南省勐仑阿克语音系简介 [A Phonological Sketch of Menglun Akeu, Yunnan, China]. 神戸外大論叢 (Kobe Gaidai Ronso) 70(1): 37-66. Kobe City University of Foreign Studies. In Chinese.
sources.note: Nothing on stress (no 重音/轻声/stress/accent anywhere in the text layer). §4 声调 (p. 46): Menglun Akeu has three main tones 55, 33, 21, plus marginal 35 and 53 in a few words; syllable structure C1C2VC3/T with T = tone on every syllable; wordlist of ~600 items all tone-marked, no stress marks.

sources.citation: Wikipedia, 'Akeu language' (accessed 2026-09-17); cites Hayashi 2015 (SEALS 25), Kosonen 2015 numerals, Lew 2023, You 2013.
sources.note: No stress statement; only numerals with tone numbers. Confirms Hayashi 2015 is a SEALS 25 conference paper with no URL.

sources.note: Numerals with tone letters only (e.g. tɯ³¹, hɛ⁵⁵, tɕʰɤ⁵⁵); no statement about stress.
